questions.q: Who made Karin's first red shoes?
o: A rich shoemaker from the city
An old village cobbler woman, from scraps of red leather
questions.e: The old cobbler woman made them from old pieces of red leather.

questions.q: What did the old lady do with those shoes?
o: Gave them to a poor girl
questions.e: She found them hideous and threw them into the fire.

questions.q: What was Karin thinking about in church during the ceremony?
questions.e: She thought only of the shoes while the priest laid his hand on her head.

questions.q: What happened when the old soldier said, “What pretty shoes for dancing!”?
o: The shoes made Karin dance and she could not stop
questions.e: The shoes took control and her feet kept dancing.

questions.q: Why did Karin go to the ball when the old lady was ill?
o: She couldn't resist and put on the red shoes
She wanted to say goodbye to friends
questions.e: She looked at the red shoes, put them on and went to the dance.

questions.q: How did Karin get rid of the shoes?
o: She drowned them in a river
The executioner chopped off her feet along with the shoes
questions.e: The executioner struck her feet with his axe.

o: The shoes came back to her
An angel came to her, and she died in peace and joy, her soul flying to Heaven
She returned to the village rich
questions.e: Her soul flew up to Heaven on the sunbeams.
